decisions.reason: Height-adjustable executive desks match post-pandemic demand for flexible, representative workplaces and the firm's office strategy.
A chair family close to the core offer serves both residential and contract customers and typically has a long life in premium furniture ranges.
Carpet floor cushions are a low-cost niche add-on to the rug line, but after four years with no visible web presence they are the likeliest to be pruned.
A high standing table supports flexible meeting and lounge setups and is cheap to keep, though it is a small item that could be consolidated.
The rug collection is a flagship of the firm's direction toward natural, holistic interiors, so management will likely continue supporting it despite its distance from the core offer.
